objective: Retain high-value PRC intelligence capabilities while keeping production free-first, read-only, replaceable and compliant with the repository tool-admission policy.
production_rule: A tool may be production_enabled only when the active capability is zero-cost, no automatic paid overage, read-only, bounded, license-scoped, does not require personal login state, and contains no proxy/CAPTCHA/fingerprint/denial-evasion path.

tools.fallback: new independent task against official public company sources; never bypass an upstream denial
tools.notes: Hosted free tier is not treated as permanent contractual SLA; health checks and structured stop are mandatory.

tools.fallback: canonical company source URLs and existing web retrieval
tools.notes: Periodic snapshot; attribution is preserved and the live paid verification layer is not used.

tools.integration: official ccgp.gov.cn source already registered in PRC source plans; retain parser/scoring design as reference
tools.fallback: Tavily/Exa discovery then direct ccgp.gov.cn verification
tools.notes: Do not vendor the crawler as a production dependency; use official public pages and preserve its conservative no-proxy/no-CAPTCHA principles.

tools.integration: approved parser candidate behind fixed HTML input boundary
tools.notes: Useful parser, but keep as separable optional component so copyleft and dependency upgrades cannot silently change the main runtime.

tools.integration: self-host candidate only; never depend on a public community instance as a production SLA
tools.fallback: direct official RSS/Atom or existing web retrieval
tools.notes: Routes can break when source sites change; route-level health checks are required before promotion.

tools.integration: monitoring architecture/reference; existing radar remains primary
tools.fallback: existing Information Tool Radar + RSS + web search
tools.notes: Avoid duplicate production stack while retaining its source/monitoring design as an upgrade candidate.

tools.integration: local deterministic NLP candidate; model assets require separate license and reproducibility review
tools.fallback: existing text processing and model-free normalization
tools.notes: Code license is suitable; do not auto-download arbitrary models at runtime.

tools.notes: Its TLS fingerprint evasion behavior is not admitted; no evasion code enters production.
